editor_reconstruction_note: A white panel opens across the lower half from the left edge (f75 narrow strip at far left, f78 about 60% width, f81 full width) revealing 'EARTH' label, black-ink stick figure, tree, small squirrel, chair and a stippled air cloud. Space figure unchanged. Wipe mechanism between tiles UNRESOLVED.

Small black arrows/ticks appear around the Earth figure, tree, squirrel and chair inside the stippled cloud (heat leaving by contact); space half unchanged. Exact arrow count unreadable at tile scale.
Second white label 'ANSWER: RADIANT HEAT' (small text) appears under the title; a ring of small white arrows pointing outward appears around the space figure. Both in one frame.
Hard cut to full-canvas black space with grey Earth limb (two-tone grey continents, Europe) filling lower-right with a white dashed atmosphere line; only title label retained; no stick figures.
Small label 'PART 1' appears under the title; nothing else changes.
White formula built up in the middle: f339 shows only 'T=' with a fragment, f341 shows 'T = 2/3k_B · KE_average' (fraction, subscript B, subscript 'average'). Typed or written-on over about 3 frames.
Five white starburst particles with curved white trajectory lines rising above the Earth limb appear at once, left to right, below the formula.
White stick figure with helmet (small, tilted, lower-left, leaning on a trail) appears with hand-lettered text 'THIS IS THE HOTTEST PLACE I'VE EVER GOTTEN FROSTBITE' above-left of its head.
Hard cut to white canvas with black ink: tall stick figure with goggles holding a grinder over a table/bench, small child stick figure at left, bench at right. No sparks, no labels.
Group of small spark burst marks with short trails appears at the grinder wheel and spreads over the adult's torso and child (several sparks in a stream toward the lower left).
Label '~2000°F (1100°C)' appears upper-right with a short leader line to a spark near the adult's face.
Hard cut to white canvas with a thin black curved horizontal line, label 'PAPA MUNROE'S SKIN' below it; one spark with trail (zigzag line) arriving from upper right to the line.
Spark and zigzag trail replaced by a small dot at the line with a thin wavy wisp of smoke rising above it; label unchanged.

Hard cut back to black space with grey Europe limb now with a pale blue tint on the dashed atmosphere line; title label; white submarine (smooth white fill, tail fins, conning tower with small red-white mark unreadable) mid-canvas with three spark bursts with trails around it.

Over 6 frames the three sparks and trails fade to nothing and the submarine body fill changes from plain white to a hatched/textured fill (crowd of small marks). Intermediate frame f1312 shows faint sparks and hatching.
Row of small white arrows appears around the submarine: upward along the top, downward along the bottom, angled at the ends.
Label 'PART 2' appears under the title; nothing else changes.
Arrows around submarine replaced by a small white fan on a stand at right end of the submarine with multiple curved white wind lines streaming left along the body.
Fan and wind lines removed; hatched submarine alone remains, no arrows.
Small upward and downward arrows reappear around the submarine; they are shorter and more spaced than in G0032, and there are small curved ends. Detail unreadable at tile scale.
Hard cut to black space with no Earth, no title label: tilted white-and-grey spacecraft capsule wearing a grey knit hat with pom-pom and a grey scarf, with curved trailing lines at lower left.
Hat and scarf removed; the bare capsule remains in same pose and place with same trailing lines.
